user.title: YaHome Hub
user.description: Choose how to sign in to Yandex.

menu_options.login_qr: Sign in with a QR code

login_token.title: Sign in with a Yandex IoT token
login_token.description: Paste a Yandex IoT API OAuth token. Add browser cookies to enable speakers and devices connected to a Yandex Station. How to get cookies: [instructions]({cookies_url}).

login_cookies.title: Sign in with cookies
login_cookies.description: Paste Yandex cookies. How to get them: [instructions]({cookies_url}).

login_qr.title: Sign in with a QR code
login_qr.description: Open the [link]({qr_url}) or scan the QR code in the Yandex app. {qr_data}

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate YaHome Hub
reauth_confirm.description: The token or cookies have expired. Enter new values.

reconfigure_manual.title: Update YaHome Hub access
reconfigure_manual.description: Update the token and cookies without removing the integration. How to get cookies: [instructions]({cookies_url}).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the API.
error.cookies: Unable to exchange cookies for a speaker token.
error.no_devices: No devices found in the account.
error.qr_pending: The QR code is not confirmed yet. Scan it and press Submit.
error.qr_not_started: QR sign-in was not started. Press Submit to get a new QR code.

abort.cookies_not_found: No cookies found in Home Assistant. Sign in to the yandex_station integration or enter cookies manually.
abort.cookies_failed: The found cookies were rejected. Enter cookies manually.

data.only_station_devices: Show only devices connected to a Station
